next.reason: 1985: 'The key word FILLER may be used to name a data item. Under no circumstances can a FILLER item be referred to explicitly', and FILLER may name a conditional variable. §2023:13.18.20.4 GR1: 'The word FILLER may be used to name a data, report, or screen item. Under no circumstances shall a FILLER item be referred to explicitly.' The conditional-variable allowance survives: §2023:13.16.3 SR24 lets a condition-name be associated with 'any data description entry that contains a level-number' except a list that does not name FILLER items. Same programs, same meaning.
